# Relay Relay moves jobs from a queue to workers. It retries a failed job three times, then parks it.
Why not a cron job? A cron job cannot see that a worker died. Relay does, and gives the job to another worker.
## Install ```sh npm install relay ``` ## Use Create a queue, then start a worker. Press Ctrl+C to stop it. ```ts import { createQueue } from "relay"; const queue = createQueue({ name: "mail", retries: 3, backoff: "fixed", }); queue.add({ to: "team@example.com" }); ``` The config file is JSON: ```json { "workers": 4, "park": true } ``` ![Architecture](docs/arch.png) See the [API notes](docs/api.md), the [install steps](#install) and the [changelog](https://example.com/changelog). - Jobs run at least once. - A parked job waits for a person.
